'''Dantooine's Wrath''' was a dangerous quadrant of space located in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] that was occupied by the [[Sserician Eclipse]]. It was regularly patrolled by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] along with those of Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
